note: A fictitious show, kept deliberately separate from every real input so it can never be confused with one and can be deleted in a single step. See the `fixture` provenance status: every field on this record carries it, and the UI renders it as a loud TEST DATA chip rather than as any grade that implies sourcing. Nothing here describes a real event. There is no such festival, the venue is invented, and the numbers are plausible fabrications chosen to exercise the features rather than to inform a decision.

show.editorialNote: A practice show. Nothing on this record is real — not the festival, not the venue, not a single number.
